tei:div.tei:p: O King girded with might, great is Thy Name in might, Thine is an arm with might. The King is clothed in vestments of vengeance on the day of vengeance, He requites His enemies to their bosom. The King is clothed in majesty, He dries the seas and subdues the pride of rivers.
The King with ten vestments has girded Himself among holy ones, God who is adored in the council of the holy, is holy.

The King who dwells in light, who wears light like a robe, will issue our verdict as if it were light. The King has girded Himself with strength, His right hand shows strength while man has no strength. The King is clothed in righteousness and sanctified through righteousness. Thine, O Lord, is righteousness. This King splendid in His clothing with a helmet of salvation upon His head, God is seated on His holy throne. The King whose vestments are crimson when He treads down renegades and lowers the spirit of princes. The King whose cloak is like purified snow, is pure and in purity purifies those who purify their work to triumph. The King is draped in zeal, He is enflamed with zeal, He carries Himself high, like a warrior does He arouse zeal. The King — all the ends of the earth bow down to the King over all the earth when He comes to judge the earth. The King, on the day when He rises for ever, every creature will tremble before Him, lofty and exalted and eternal. The
King, who rules the world in His might, mountains quake before His majesty and jump like rams before His rebuke. The King, awe-inspiring to the kings of the earth, the earth is surely quaking before Him who dwells above the Cherubim, the earth trembles. The King, who has the strength to bear Him? For He bears all with strength and to the weary does He grant strength. The King, when He rises to give judgment on the day of judgment, to judge the proud in judgment. The King searches out the secret of those who go deep to conceal a plan in the depths, and He reveals and exposes the things that are deep. O King, command that the haughty tyrants should be hemmed in from every side by the fury of the tempest. The King assembles the kings of the earth when He fulfils in the storm the prophesyprophecy of Duma, then will He reckon with the host of the summit. The King, high and exalted in judgment, the might of the King loves judgment, the foundation of His throne is justice and judgment. The King is the just Judge, justice walks before Him, to plead for those who strive for justice. The King mighty in dominion, His throne is suspended above, His realm prevails over all. The King makes the earth quake with His glance, He shakes the foundations with His glance, over all there roams His glance. The King searches every creature, and all that he may do both below and above.
The King is God of eternity, the eternal people has crowned Him. The Lord rules unto eternity, the Holy One.
